entities.name: Header compression configuration
entities.description: Information element that contains header compression configuration parameters for the UE.

entities.name: PDN type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the PDN type (IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6).

entities.name: UE network capability
entities.description: Information element that indicates the UE's network capabilities including support for Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by the UE to initiate an attach procedure.

entities.name: PDN type is IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6
entities.description: Condition where the PDN type IE value is set to IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6.

entities.name: Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization supported
entities.description: Condition where the UE indicates support for Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization in the UE network capability IE.

entities.name: UE supports header compression
entities.description: Condition where the UE has header compression support capability.

relations.description: The ATTACH REQUEST message may contain the Header compression configuration IE under specified conditions.
The ATTACH REQUEST message contains the UE network capability IE.
The ATTACH REQUEST message contains the PDN type IE.
Inclusion of Header compression configuration IE is guarded by the condition that PDN type is IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6.
Inclusion of Header compression configuration IE is guarded by the condition that UE indicates Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization support.
Inclusion of Header compression configuration IE is guarded by the condition that the UE supports header compression.
